HZvbpL-b24d5CFNZlk83qw.zh: 印2024年截至今年5/20累計報告256例疑病例及23例漢他病毒出血熱併腎症候群(HFRS) 確定病例,其中確定病例有3例死亡(CFR為13%),該國病例病毒基因定序皆為首爾型漢他病毒,疫情呈逐年增加趨勢,分佈於雅加達特區等6個省份。另全球估計有1至10萬例感染病例,以亞洲及歐洲負擔較重。
HZvbpL-b24d5CFNZlk83qw.en: Indonesia reported 256 suspected cases and 23 confirmed cases of haemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome (HFRS) caused by hantavirus from 2024 through 20 May this year. Three of the confirmed cases died (CFR 13%). Viral gene sequencing of the cases identified Seoul hantavirus. The outbreak shows an increasing trend year on year and is distributed across six provinces, including the Special Capital Region of Jakarta. Globally, an estimated 1 to 100,000 infections occur, with a heavier burden in Asia and Europe.

oprXpTE3tYKmE48ZsTbjJg.zh: 印近期疫情升溫,多國報告旅遊相關病例。法國自2025下半年至今年3月累計報告11例境外移入確診病例(多具峇里島旅遊史),德國今年亦報告2例確診病例。當局呼籲赴該區旅客落實防蚊,孕婦與計畫受孕者須特別提高警覺。
oprXpTE3tYKmE48ZsTbjJg.en: Transmission has recently risen in Indonesia, and several countries have reported travel-related cases. France reported 11 imported confirmed cases cumulatively from the second half of 2025 to March this year, most with a history of travel to Bali. Germany has reported two confirmed cases this year. Authorities urge travellers to the area to protect themselves against mosquitoes, and pregnant women and those planning pregnancy should take particular care.

HazDuv1ky8aHNRk16Tt_8A.zh: 印2025年報告706,000例病例,為該國近年來最高,主要分布於東部地區,尤其巴布亞省,人口流動造成疾病由流行地區傳播至其他地區,如2024年廖内省部分地區再度發生疫情,導致2026年初當地多次宣布進入疫情緊急狀態,此外,氣候變遷及資金缺乏亦為影響疫情上升的因素。該國於2023及2024年分別報告418,000及543,000例病例。
HazDuv1ky8aHNRk16Tt_8A.en: Indonesia reported 706,000 malaria cases in 2025, the highest in recent years, mainly in eastern regions, especially Papua Province. Population movement has spread the disease from endemic areas to other regions; for example, parts of Riau Province experienced an outbreak again in 2024, and local authorities declared outbreak emergency status several times in early 2026. Climate change and funding shortages are also factors in the rising trend. The country reported 418,000 cases in 2023 and 543,000 in 2024.

oY8PHyY1gfEPGAOyW1qObw.zh: 日本疫情急遽上升,第 15 週單週新增 56 例確定病例,今年截至4/15 累計報告 299 例,其中 30 例為境外移入病例,感染國家以印及紐西蘭為多,年齡層以 15-29 年齡層為多(占 50%),分布以東京都 108 例、神奈川縣 31 例及鹿兒島縣 28 例為多,61%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明,當局呼籲民眾確認兒童按時接種疫苗,另前往流行地區應採取相關防疫措施。 英國今年截至 4/13 累計報告 407 例確定病例,病例數以倫敦 229 例及西密德蘭郡(West Midlands)100 例為多,另所有地區皆有報告至少 1 例確定病例。該國去(2024)年報告 959 例確定病例。 歐盟今年 2 月共計 11 國報告 139 例確定病例,以義大利(63 例)、西班牙(36 例)為多。近 12 個月(2025/3/1-2026/2/28)共計 30 國報告 4,623 例病例,其中 6 例死亡,病例數以羅馬亞(1,587 例)、法國(754 例)、義大利(534 例)為多,其中 79.9%病患未接種疫苗。
oY8PHyY1gfEPGAOyW1qObw.en: Japan's outbreak has risen sharply: 56 confirmed cases were reported in week 15 alone, and as of 15 April this year, 299 cases had been reported cumulatively, of which 30 were imported. The countries of infection were mainly India and New Zealand. Those aged 15–29 accounted for the largest share (50%). Cases were concentrated in Tokyo Metropolis (108), Kanagawa Prefecture (31) and Kagoshima Prefecture (28). 61% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. Authorities urge the public to confirm that children are vaccinated on schedule and to take appropriate precautions when travelling to epidemic areas. The UK reported 407 confirmed cases cumulatively this year as of 13 April. Cases are concentrated in London (229) and West Midlands County (100), and every region has reported at least one confirmed case. The UK reported 959 confirmed cases last year (2024). In February this year, 11 EU countries reported 139 confirmed cases, mainly Italy (63) and Spain (36). In the past 12 months (1 March 2025 to 28 February 2026), 30 countries reported 4,623 cases, including six deaths, with the largest numbers in Romania (1,587), France (754) and Italy (534); 79.9% of patients were unvaccinated.

jTAnd9zsPVFgE2XpMwHvwg.zh: 印南蘇拉威西省望加錫市等 7 個地區爆發疫情,為繼近期全國疫情後局部地區的再次爆發,自去(2025)年 12 月起,至今年 3 月持續上升,已累計報告 169 例兒童確定病例,多數病患為未接種疫苗兒童。由於疫情於全國流行,當局發布命令請各地區進行風險評估,並針對該省發布警報並啟動緊急疫苗接種作業。
jTAnd9zsPVFgE2XpMwHvwg.en: Seven areas, including Makassar City in South Sulawesi Province, have experienced outbreaks. This follows a recent nationwide outbreak and represents a renewed local resurgence. From December 2025 through March 2026, cases continued to rise, with 169 confirmed pediatric cases reported cumulatively; most patients were unvaccinated children. Because the outbreak is circulating nationally, authorities have issued an order requiring each region to conduct a risk assessment, and have issued an alert for the province and launched emergency vaccination operations.

PfJ1A80V7hppW7z58aOIeQ.zh: 日本疫情上升,今(2026)年截至 4/8 累計報告 236 例,其中 30 例為境外移入病例,感染國家以印12例為多,其次為紐西蘭7例,以 15-29 年齡層為多(占 50%),分布以東京都 72 例、鹿兒島縣27 例、愛知縣 23 例及神奈川/千葉縣 20 例為多。 美國疫情持續,今年截至 4/9 共 33 州累計報告 1,704 例確定病例,其中 96 例住院,病患以 5-19 歲年齡層族群(888 例)為多,主要分佈於南卡羅來納州(667 例),其次為猶他州(408)及德州(176 例),近期疫情主要集中於猶他州。
PfJ1A80V7hppW7z58aOIeQ.en: Japan's outbreak is rising: as of 8 April this year, 236 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 30 were imported. Indonesia accounted for the most imported cases (12), followed by New Zealand (7). Cases are concentrated in the 15–29 age group (50%); by location, Tokyo Metropolis (72 cases), Kagoshima Prefecture (27), Aichi Prefecture (23) and Kanagawa and Chiba Prefectures (20) reported the most. The United States outbreak continues: as of 9 April, 1,704 confirmed cases have been reported across 33 states this year, of which 96 were hospitalized. Patients are mainly aged 5–19 years (888 cases), concentrated in South Carolina (667 cases), followed by Utah (408) and Texas (176). Recent activity has been concentrated in Utah.

V0agBIgqaaPdXCUPz_Vr2Q.zh: 疫情更新:  今年第7週(2/9-15)全球陽性率為3.28%,與上週3.31%相當,其中美洲區署陽性率明顯增加。 香港疫情於低點持平,第9週(2/22-28)陽性率為0.08%,汙水監測變異株以NB.1.8.1為多(占62.8%)。 印疫情略升,第7週陽性率上升為3.67%。 澳洲疫情呈上升趨勢,1/26-2/22平均陽性率為2.2%,疫情已連續4週上升,近期變異株以XFG占多數(占33.7%);另近1年成人疫苗覆蓋率為10%,其中以75歲以上覆蓋率(38.5%)為高。  評估與建議: 近期全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高(占56.16%),其次為NB.1.8.1(25.37%)。WHO公布之全球長期快速風險評估(第9版),評估對全球公共衛生的整體風險屬中等。鑑於自然感染與疫苗帶來的群體免疫力提升,以及臨床治療的進步,全球住院與死亡數自2022年以來明顯下降。 目前多數流行變異株為Omicron JN.1及其衍生亞型,雖具備免疫逃脫能力,惟不至於造成疾病嚴重度增加,僅有6%的有症狀病例出現長新冠症狀;現階段尚未形成穩定季節性流行規律,多數國家已減少常規檢測通報,汙水與定醫監測成為重要的補充監測方式。 WHO指出,目前疫苗仍能有效預防重症與死亡,並建議優先保護高風險族群、與流感疫苗共同施打;同時透過《冠狀病毒疾病威脅管理策略計畫》呼籲各國整合防治計畫,持續加強監測、保護高風險族群、維持醫療與公衛韌性,並落實風險溝通。
V0agBIgqaaPdXCUPz_Vr2Q.en: Epidemic update: In week 7 of this year (9–15 February), the global positivity rate was 3.28%, similar to 3.31% the previous week, with a notable increase in the WHO Regional Office for the Americas. Hong Kong's epidemic has remained flat at a low point; the positivity rate in week 9 (22–28 February) was 0.08%, and NB.1.8.1 was the predominant variant in wastewater surveillance (62.8%). India's epidemic has risen slightly, with the positivity rate rising to 3.67% in week 7. Australia's epidemic is rising: the average positivity rate for 26 January–22 February was 2.2%, and it has risen for four consecutive weeks, with XFG the majority of recent variants (33.7%). In addition, adult vaccination coverage over the past year was 10%, with higher coverage among people aged 75 and over (38.5%). Assessment and recommendations: XFG currently has the highest share of circulating variants globally (56.16%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (25.37%). WHO's global long-term rapid risk assessment (9th edition) rates the overall risk to global public health as moderate. Given population immunity from natural infection and vaccination, and advances in clinical treatment, global hospitalizations and deaths have declined markedly since 2022. Most circulating variants are Omicron JN.1 and its descendant subtypes; although they have immune escape capacity, they do not cause greater disease severity, but only 6% of symptomatic cases develop long COVID symptoms. COVID-19 has not yet established a stable seasonal pattern, and most countries have reduced routine testing and reporting, so wastewater and sentinel physician surveillance have become important supplementary methods. WHO notes that current vaccines remain effective at preventing severe disease and death, and recommends prioritizing high-risk groups and co-administration with influenza vaccines. Through its Strategic Plan for Coronavirus Disease Threat Management, WHO calls on countries to integrate prevention and control plans, continue strengthening surveillance, protect high-risk groups, maintain health system and public health resilience, and implement risk communication.

gKtBSPfc1u_0vfD75q6LTA.zh: 印今年截至第7週報告572例確定病例,其中4例死亡,另共計11省分報告21起疑(13起確診)疫情,當局已加強監測及調查作業;該國去年報告逾1.1萬確定病例,其中69例死亡。 美國疫情持續,今年截至2/26共28州累計報告1,136例確定病例,其中58例住院,92%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明,病例數以南卡羅來納州報告653例確定病例為多,其次為猶他州(149例)及佛羅里達州(107例)。USCDC 剛果民主共和國今年截至2/10共26省累計20,231例疑病例,其中238例死亡,去(2025)年同期報告7,491例,其中93例死亡。該國2018年5歲以下孩童疫苗接種率僅57%,當局呼籲家長攜帶孩童至疫苗接種場所完成接種。
gKtBSPfc1u_0vfD75q6LTA.en: Indonesia reported 572 confirmed cases this year through week 7, including 4 deaths. Eleven provinces reported 21 outbreaks (13 confirmed), and authorities have strengthened surveillance and investigation. Last year, Indonesia reported more than 11,000 confirmed cases, including 69 deaths. The United States outbreak continues: as of 26 February this year, 1,136 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively across 28 states, of which 58 were hospitalized; 92% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. Cases are concentrated in South Carolina, with 653 confirmed cases, followed by Utah (149 cases) and Florida (107 cases) (US CDC). In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, as of 10 February this year, 20,231 suspected cases have been reported cumulatively across 26 provinces, including 238 deaths. In the same period last year, 7,491 cases were reported, including 93 deaths. The country's vaccination coverage among children under 5 years was only 57% in 2018, and authorities urge parents to take children to vaccination sites to complete vaccination.

FXJo3Z34RsjzxtXssuawcw.zh: 印東爪哇省帕梅卡桑縣去(2025)年累計報告1,248例疑病例,其中,209例經實驗室確診,12人死亡,確診/死亡病例主要為1-4歲兒童,約78%確診病患未曾接種疫苗,由於疫情持續迅速傳播,該縣宣布其18個村莊疫情為重大公共衛生事件,並啟動家戶主動訪視之疫苗接種作業。該國去年截至8月累計報告逾2.3萬疑病例(3,444例確診),相較2023-24年之10,628例及3,520例為高。 美國南卡羅來納州於今年1/7-9新增99例確定病例,病患主要集中於斯帕坦堡( Spartanburg),累計病例數達310例,當局已匡列200名接觸者並發布警報,建議醫療機構提高警覺及落實個人防護措施。該國去年共44州累計報告2,144例確定病例,其中240例住院、3例死亡,93%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明。該國近年疫苗接種率持續落後,近期疫情集中於南卡羅來納/北卡羅來納州。 智利報告1例境外移入確定病例,為居住於聖地牙哥首都大區43歲女性,當局調查可能感染地點為2025/12/15-19於西班牙馬德里舉行之國際會議,病患於31日搭乘智利南美航空(LATAM Chile, LA 8118)自烏拉圭蒙特維多機場返回智利,當局已啟動接觸者聯繫及安排其疫苗接種作業並加強疫情監測。
FXJo3Z34RsjzxtXssuawcw.en: In Pamekasan Regency, East Java province, Indonesia, 1,248 suspected cases were reported cumulatively last year (2025), of which 209 were laboratory-confirmed and 12 people died. Confirmed and fatal cases were mainly children aged 1–4, and about 78% of confirmed patients were unvaccinated. As the outbreak continued to spread rapidly, the regency declared the outbreak in its 18 villages a major public health incident and launched household vaccination outreach. Indonesia reported more than 23,000 suspected cases through August last year (3,444 confirmed), higher than the 10,628 suspected and 3,520 confirmed cases in 2023–24. In the United States, South Carolina added 99 confirmed cases on 7–9 January this year, mainly in Spartanburg, bringing the cumulative total to 310. Authorities have identified 200 contacts, issued an alert, and recommended that healthcare facilities remain vigilant and implement personal protective measures. Last year, the United States reported 2,144 confirmed cases across 44 states, including 240 hospitalisations and 3 deaths; 93% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. US vaccination rates have continued to lag in recent years, and recent activity is concentrated in South Carolina and North Carolina. Chile reported one imported confirmed case, a 43-year-old woman residing in the Santiago Metropolitan Region. Authorities investigated that she may have been infected at an international conference held in Madrid, Spain, from 15 to 19 December 2025. The patient returned to Chile on LATAM Chile flight LA 8118 from Montevideo airport in Uruguay on the 31st. Authorities have activated contact tracing, arranged vaccination, and strengthened surveillance.

Ba0txfIw-yaEeTEb6mjKXg.zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第44週(10/27-11/2)全球陽性率6.16%,其中,非洲區署陽性率增加。 日本疫情呈下降趨勢,第45週(11/3-9)定醫平均報告數1.95,較前1週下降,分布以北海道、愛知縣為多,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 韓國疫情呈下降趨勢,第46(11/9-15)報告住院145例,陽性率降為4.1%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 印疫情上升,第44週陽性率上升至7.46%,今年迄今累計報告505例病例。 英國疫情下降,第45週醫院監測陽性率降為5%,住院數亦下降,以變異株XFG占比最高;另本流感季75歲以上年齡層疫苗覆蓋率為56.5%。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈下降趨勢,惟非洲區署呈上升趨勢;全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高,其次為NB.1.8.1。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
Ba0txfIw-yaEeTEb6mjKXg.en: Update: The global positivity rate in week 44 of 2025 (27 October–2 November) was 6.16%, and the WHO African Region saw an increase in positivity. Japan: The outbreak is declining. In week 45 (3–9 November), the average number of reports per sentinel clinic was 1.95, lower than the previous week; cases are concentrated in Hokkaido and Aichi prefecture, and the variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share. South Korea: The outbreak is declining. In week 46 (9–15 November), 145 hospitalizations were reported and the positivity rate fell to 4.1%; the variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share. Indonesia: The outbreak is rising. In week 44, the positivity rate rose to 7.46%, and 505 cases have been reported cumulatively this year. United Kingdom: The outbreak is declining. In week 45, the hospital surveillance positivity rate fell to 5% and hospitalizations also declined; the variant XFG has the highest share. In addition, vaccination coverage among people aged 75 and over this flu season is 56.5%. Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently been declining, but the African Region is rising. The globally circulating variant with the highest share is XFG, followed by NB.1.8.1. WHO says most countries have included COVID-19 in routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and reliable testing, treatment and vaccines to the public, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report outbreak information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

79EBam7aLp2bXIRRyvFC-Q.zh: 墨西哥今年截至8/22累計報告4,200餘例,其中契瓦瓦州逾3,900例為多,死亡數累計15例,病例集中於0-4歲嬰幼兒族群。 印東爪哇省今年迄今報告逾2,000例,其中17例死亡,病例多集中於漯水縣(Sumenep),病患多未接種疫苗或未完整接種疫苗,當局已宣布進入公共衛生緊急狀態,該國東部巴布亞省於2018年爆發大規模疫情,造成數十例死亡。因該國疫苗接種率僅72%,部分省分低於50%,疫苗覆蓋率不佳,疫情與接種覆蓋率之波動有關,當局呼籲民眾儘速接種疫苗。
79EBam7aLp2bXIRRyvFC-Q.en: Mexico has reported more than 4,200 cases this year as of 22 August, of which more than 3,900 are in Chihuahua State, and 15 deaths cumulatively; cases are concentrated among infants and young children aged 0–4. East Java Province, Indonesia, has reported more than 2,000 cases this year, including 17 deaths. Cases are concentrated in Sumenep Regency, and most patients were unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated. Authorities have declared a public health emergency. Papua Province in eastern Indonesia had a large-scale outbreak in 2018 that caused dozens of deaths. With national vaccination coverage at only 72%, and below 50% in some provinces, poor vaccination coverage is linked to fluctuations in the outbreak; authorities urge people to get vaccinated as soon as possible.

KpXJS-QiaNyZBxaWghEFMg.zh: 全球今年迄今累計報告逾360萬例病例及2,000例死亡,以美洲地區報告逾330萬例病例為多,其中病例主要分布於巴西;今年亞洲地區之印累計89,845例病例、馬來西亞35,348例、斯里蘭卡31,544例、越南28,787例、泰國24,372例及孟加拉20,218例;非洲地區累計10國報告9,266例病例及18例死亡。
KpXJS-QiaNyZBxaWghEFMg.en: Globally, more than 3.6 million cases and 2,000 deaths have been cumulatively reported this year, with the Americas region accounting for more than 3.3 million cases, mainly in Brazil. In Asia this year, Indonesia has cumulatively reported 89,845 cases, Malaysia 35,348, Sri Lanka 31,544, Viet Nam 28,787, Thailand 24,372 and Bangladesh 20,218. In Africa, 10 countries have reported 9,266 cases and 18 deaths cumulatively.

-SW_sE7TSRRPdSJA-kh1vw.zh: 印峇里島西部珍布拉娜縣(Jembrana Regency)今年截至7/7報告64例病例,當局已宣布南庫塔(South Kuta)、孟威區(Mengwi)為紅色警告地區,其中包含丹戎貝諾瓦(Tanjung Benoa)、努沙杜瓦(Nusa Dua)和金巴蘭灣(Jimbaran Bay)等熱門度假勝地,並啟動大規模犬隻疫苗接種作業,另提醒遊客及當地居民應遠離犬隻及猿猴,倘被抓咬傷,應立即就醫。該國今年1-3月,共通報13,453起咬傷事件及25例死亡。
-SW_sE7TSRRPdSJA-kh1vw.en: In Jembrana Regency in western Bali, 64 cases have been reported so far this year, as of 7 July. Authorities have declared South Kuta and Mengwi as red-alert areas, including popular resorts such as Tanjung Benoa, Nusa Dua and Jimbaran Bay, and have launched large-scale dog vaccination. Residents and travelers are reminded to stay away from dogs and monkeys, and to seek medical care immediately if bitten or scratched. Nationally, 13,453 animal bite incidents and 25 deaths were reported in January–March this year.

e5OM0BpSmdepgMlLEODbww.en: Four provinces in Indonesia reported 8 cases, from Yogyakarta, West Java, East Nusa Tenggara and North Sulawesi. All patients have recovered.

jU-KHn_zaI-DkeYOXTZ5FA.en: Indonesia update: as of May this year, nationwide cumulative reports exceed 56,000 cases, including 250 deaths. Last year's epidemic was severe, with nearly 250,000 cases reported, of which more than 1,400 were fatal. Brazil update: from January to May this year, nearly 2.71 million cases have been reported cumulatively, mainly in São Paulo State in the southeast of the country.

CpzFOSHHjeXLviR3vu9jsQ.zh: 斯里蘭卡疫情上升,今年迄今累計11,400餘例病例及7例死亡,當局已採取疾病防治計畫;該國2024年累計逾5萬例病例。 印疫情更新,今年截至2/16累計10,700餘例病例及48例死亡;該國2024年累計逾20萬例病例及1,400餘例死亡。
CpzFOSHHjeXLviR3vu9jsQ.en: Dengue activity is rising in Sri Lanka, with over 11,400 cases and 7 deaths reported so far this year. Authorities have implemented a disease prevention and control plan. The country recorded over 50,000 cases in 2024. Indonesia update: as of 16 February this year, over 10,700 cases and 48 deaths have been reported cumulatively; in 2024 the country recorded over 200,000 cases and more than 1,400 deaths.

QltM9WiuerJ7VNU1yUQilA.zh: 印峇里島2/28報告新增1例死亡病例,該病患為35歲男子,於半年前被流浪狗咬傷,僅清洗傷口,惟未注射疫苗,2/22出現症狀,於24日發燒後死亡。當局呼籲民眾,倘被犬隻咬傷,應盡速施打狂犬病疫苗。另該島於去年共累計7例死亡病例,近56,000人被咬傷。
QltM9WiuerJ7VNU1yUQilA.en: Bali, Indonesia, reported one new death on 28 February: a 35-year-old man bitten by a stray dog six months earlier. He only washed the wound and did not receive a rabies vaccine. Symptoms began on 22 February, he developed fever on 24 February, and he died. Authorities urge anyone bitten by a dog to get a rabies vaccination as soon as possible. Last year the island recorded 7 cumulative deaths, and nearly 56,000 people were bitten.

GCHCQpfovuxjf8jRTRFBeg.zh: 印疫情上升,依據去年12月資料顯示,該國7個省報告571例病例,於去年底及今年初病例數呈上升趨勢,該國衛生部對今年屈公病病例數上升及突發公共衛生事件(KLB)發布警報。
GCHCQpfovuxjf8jRTRFBeg.en: Indonesia's outbreak is rising. According to December data, 7 provinces reported 571 cases, and case numbers have been rising since the end of last year and into this year. The Ministry of Health has issued an alert over the rise in chikungunya cases this year and declared an extraordinary public health event (KLB).

R9IScBf1w5MrZwZLzwj0sQ.zh: 孟加拉疫情更新,最近1天內新增逾18例病例,今年迄今累計1,300餘例病例及12例死亡,2024年累計101,200餘例病例。 印疫情更新,南蘇門答臘省今年1月報告4名登革出血熱死亡案例,該省今年迄今累計309例登革出血熱病例,以巨港市最多。
R9IScBf1w5MrZwZLzwj0sQ.en: Bangladesh update: over 18 new cases were reported in the last day. So far this year, over 1,300 cases and 12 deaths have been reported cumulatively, and over 101,200 cases were recorded in 2024. Indonesia update: in South Sumatra Province, 4 deaths from dengue haemorrhagic fever were reported in January this year. So far this year the province has reported 309 cumulative dengue haemorrhagic fever cases, most of them in Palembang City.

vJs3_0ExWQtiyOi_splGpg.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於1/1-1/8期間,巴基斯坦報告新增1例WPV1型病例;共2國新增4例cVDPV2型病例,分別為奈及利亞3例、印1例。環境樣本部分,巴基斯坦新增13件WPV1型陽性樣本;英國新增1例cVDPV2型陽性樣本。 2024年全年病例數,其中奈及利亞累計93例cVDPV2型,巴基斯坦累計報告68例WPV1型,剛果民主共和國累計9例cVDPV1與14例cVDPV2型,印累計7例cVDPV2型,南蘇丹10例cVDPV2 型。
vJs3_0ExWQtiyOi_splGpg.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 1–8 January, Pakistan reported one new WPV1 case. Two countries reported four new cVDPV2 cases: three in Nigeria and one in Indonesia. For environmental samples, Pakistan reported 13 new WPV1-positive samples, and the United Kingdom reported one new cVDPV2-positive sample. Full-year 2024 case counts: Nigeria cumulatively reported 93 cVDPV2 cases; Pakistan 68 WPV1 cases; the Democratic Republic of the Congo 9 cVDPV1 and 14 cVDPV2 cases; Indonesia 7 cVDPV2 cases; and South Sudan 10 cVDPV2 cases.

6-7cmsiMIu8R_15W1rZp6g.zh: 依WHO監測數據,泰國疫情於7月起驟升,達每月千餘例之規模,明顯高於往年;越南胡志明市9月起疫情爆發,疫情仍在上升,目前達每週300餘例之規模,並有擴散至鄰近同奈及平陽省之趨勢;馬來西亞今年疫情較往年嚴峻,惟下半年已趨緩;菲律賓、印疫情則持續流行,今年處於相對嚴峻之水平。
6-7cmsiMIu8R_15W1rZp6g.en: According to WHO surveillance data, Thailand's outbreak surged from July, reaching more than 1,000 cases a month, clearly higher than in previous years. In Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam, an outbreak began in September and is still rising, currently at over 300 cases a week, and is spreading to neighbouring Đồng Nai and Bình Dương provinces. Malaysia's situation this year has been more severe than in previous years, but has eased in the second half of the year. The Philippines and Indonesia continue to have ongoing epidemics, which are at a relatively severe level this year.

dgY244_1fSiG-RktJJFG0A.zh: 印疫情更新,今年截至10/19累計203,000餘例病例,其中1,210例死亡。 斯里蘭卡疫情更新,今年迄今累計42,000餘例病例,其中20例死亡。 泊爾疫情更新,今年截至10/25累計27,000餘例病例,其中11例死亡,較去年同期為低。
dgY244_1fSiG-RktJJFG0A.en:
Indonesia update: As of 19 October this year, more than 203,000 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 1,210 deaths.

Sri Lanka update: So far this year, more than 42,000 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 20 deaths.

Nepal update: As of 25 October this year, more than 27,000 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 11 deaths; this is lower than the same period last year.
